content.short: Honey Chat is a SocialFi platform on Berachain that allows creators to monetize interactions via access passes.
content.description: Honey Chat is a decentralized SocialFi platform on Berachain designed to bridge the gap between social media and Web3 ownership. It enables creators to monetize interactions through 'Access Passes,' which are social tokens tied to a bonding curve. Fans purchase these passes for exclusive content and direct access to creators. By integrating with X (Twitter) for seamless onboarding, Honey Chat lowers the barrier for Web2 users. The platform emphasizes data sovereignty, ensuring that users retain ownership of their identity and intellectual property in a transparent social environment.
